from tools import search_flights, filter_flights, search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_attractions, filter_attractions, search_nearest, sort_results, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Search for flights from Memphis to Anchorage on departure date
departure_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Memphis",
    end_airport_city="Anchorage",
    departure_date=["May 17, 2025"],
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save departure flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="departure_flights", value=departure_flights)

# Filter departure flights for first class
filtered_departure_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=departure_flights,
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save filtered departure flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=filtered_departure_flights)

# Search for flights from Anchorage to Memphis on return date
return_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Anchorage",
    end_airport_city="Memphis",
    departure_date=["May 29, 2025"],
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save return flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="return_flights", value=return_flights)

# Filter return flights for first class
filtered_return_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_flights,
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save filtered return flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return_flights)

# Search for hotels in Downtown Anchorage
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="Anchorage",
    checkin_date=["May 17, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["May 29, 2025"],
    num_rooms=1,
    stars=[5],
    has_kids_club=True,
    pool_present=True,
    breakfast_included=True
)

# Save hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

# Filter hotels for 5-star, kids club, pool, and breakfast
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    stars=[5],
    has_kids_club=True,
    pool_present=True,
    breakfast_included=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for attractions in Anchorage related to Scenic and Tony Knowles Coastal Trail
attractions = search_attractions(
    city="Anchorage",
    type=["Scenic"]
)

# Save attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions)

# Filter attractions for Tony Knowles Coastal Trail
filtered_attractions = filter_attractions(
    prior_results=attractions,
    attraction_name=["Tony Knowles Coastal Trail"]
)

# Save filtered attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_attractions", value=filtered_attractions)

print("No planning needed")
